When the universe was young, younger than anything else could have been or will ever be again, Shao and Khal danced through the sky. The sky wasn't yet, but soon it would be. They created through their game, their wager, their music. Through all creation there was two, Shao loved to make, Khal loved to reshape. Shao would make, and Khal would reshape, turning everything Shao made into something that reflected the inside of itself.

One day, an accident, mass. Born of mass, of pressure, from the eyes of Khal he decided to create. Khal had never created, but he took the Ignisara, the fire of creation, and begun to make. Khal took his right eye, the leaking glowing flowing liquid, and gave it soul, and shape. The shape was rough, molded, glowing, golden. Then with Ignisara he gave it soul, so much soul in his eye.

Shao saw what his brother had created, and took Ignisara, making a new law for the everything, the game, the music. Khal was angry, but he loved his golden child, and he gave it name, the first named creature, the first of the 12 Prime Creations, Aurelionite. The child was dangerous, Shao feared him, and Aurelionite was curious, curious of his soul, his power, could he reshape like his parent? Reshape, he thought, destroy, he felt.

Shao imprisoned the child within the Gilded Coast, only able to be entered by the path of gold, a feat of greed, impossible for the new children he would make. He was wrong.

Aurelionite is capable of the loyalty, and the one who carries the [[Halcyon Seed]] will carry his heart, and his word, and his trust.
